pages.text: $(bold)Arms Dealer Villager$()$(br2)Piran Port adds a special villager profession: $(bold)Arms Dealer$().$(br2)$(bold)Trade Contents:$()$(br)• Ammunition and shells$(br)• Special weapon parts$(br)• Ship core materials$(br)• Rare blueprints

$(bold)How to Find Arms Dealers$()$(br2)Arms dealers spawn naturally in villages or can be obtained through:$(br2)• Special workstations in villages$(br)• Trading with regular villagers to unlock$(br)• Special NPCs in dungeons$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Arms dealer prices fluctuate based on reputation. Trade frequently for discounts!
